title: Paper Trail
description: Warm paper, ink-brown text and a classic book serif for long Wikipedia reads. Every colour is set through Wikipedia's own colour tokens plus a few explicit overrides.
compatNotes: Checked on English Wikipedia article pages (Vector 2022 skin, light mode). Not tested on editing screens, special pages, the legacy Vector skin, or with Wikipedia's own dark mode turned on.

title: Quiet Focus
description: A narrow reading column with the side tools softened until you reach for them. Fewer distractions, same Wikipedia.
compatNotes: Checked on English Wikipedia article pages (Vector 2022 skin, light mode). Side panels fade to about half strength and return on hover. Not tested on editing screens or special pages.

title: Lavender Library
description: A soft lavender page around a cream reading card, with plum headings and a Palatino-style serif.
compatNotes: Checked on English Wikipedia article pages (Vector 2022 skin, light mode). Not tested on editing screens, special pages, or with Wikipedia's own dark mode turned on.

title: Terminal Green
description: Restrained green on near-black with a monospace face, inspired by old terminals. The orange bar becomes a deep green header.
compatNotes: Checked on the front page. Comment threads use Hacker News's own shades of grey for downvoted comments, which are remapped to muted green. Not tested on the submit or profile pages.

title: Sunday Edition
description: The front page set like a broadsheet: a double-ruled masthead, serif headlines and small-caps bylines on newsprint.
compatNotes: Checked on the front page. Not tested on the submit or profile pages.
